title: pricing.json
description: Every pricing constant (plan §2.2). Market-pricing-owner. NO fallback: a missing value is a hard error, never inherited from es. product_id fields and odoo_license are verify_from_odoo — the validator refuses a non-es pack that keeps es values for them.

salida_pct.description: Soporte Salida a Producción, 10% de apps (base+extras). es=0.10.

pct.description: Migración futura, 15% de apps+devs marcados. es=0.15.

product_id.description: Odoo product id for the POC line; DB-specific. es='347'.

odoo_light_user.description: Odoo Light User licence €/user/month (same price billed monthly or yearly): employees WITHOUT access to the core apps (Sales, Purchases, Projects, Accounting), HR record / limited employee self-service only; contracted through an Odoo Advisor. Rendered as its own annual line (rate × 12 × num_usuarios_light). es=4.90 (odoo.com pricelist, Spain, 2026-09-28). -1 = unverified for this market (line omitted, blocked for a live pack).

app_base_prices.description: Base price per app_id (registry canonical ids). All 13 apps required; extra keys must be namespaced.

complement_prices.description: Price per complement id (registry complements + spreadsheet extras). Keys are complement ids.

custom_complement_band.description: Policy parameter (NOT a complement price): sanity band for the unit price of an invented complement (extras_custom). Outside it => warning + explicit confirmation. es=250/5000.

recurrent_lines.description: Recurring-cost lines. 'source' marks how the value is obtained (plan §2.2). odoo_license is verify_from_odoo.

source.description: sheet_verbatim=read from spreadsheet cell, fallback only when cell is an unevaluated =ODOO.LIST; verify_from_odoo=Odoo-SA-set, confirm per country.

fallback_amount_per_user_year.description: odoo_license only. Reference = Custom (Personalizado), yearly billing, list price. es=334.80 (Standard 178.80 is a sanctioned alternative).

fallback_amount_per_user_month.description: odoo_license only. Custom, yearly billing, per month. es=27.90.

fallback_price_display.description: Verbatim formatted price string used on the =ODOO.LIST fallback path (RECURRENT_DEFAULTS). es dyn_cloud='1.080,00 € / año'.

addons.description: Multi-select add-ons. cond references an app_id (registry) or null.

cond.description: app_id gating visibility (e.g. 'proyecto') or null=always visible.

vertical.description: Vertical one-shot packs (deal.vertical in Parámetros picks one). Today only 'inbuilt' (construction). Optional: packs without verticals omit it.

pack_oneshot.description: Vertical pack, one-shot. Includes the mobile app. es=6000.

app_oneshot.description: Standalone mobile app (only without the pack). es=2500.
